cycles.label: Baseline shell audit
cycles.result: Six primary labs passed engine checks but left class ownership, name-mangling, pre-ABC abstraction, and failure recovery under-observed.

cycles.label: Candidate contrast audit
cycles.result: Attempt/repair segments and concept annotations made failure causes visible without adding arbitrary Python execution.

cycles.label: Portfolio pruning
cycles.result: Six redundant candidates were removed; three distinct examples per topic met the release rubric.

candidates.title: Student blueprint
candidates.miss: Needed an explicit learning goal.
candidates.change: Added course metadata and kept the low-context introduction.

candidates.title: Course-section defaults
candidates.miss: Class and instance ownership were only described, never contrasted.
candidates.change: Added synchronized class fallback and instance-shadow evidence.

candidates.title: Rectangle blueprint
candidates.miss: Repeated constructor and method mechanics without a new misconception.
candidates.change: Removed after comparison with the Student introduction.

candidates.title: Shared shopping cart
candidates.miss: The shell could not distinguish an accidental shared collection from instance state.
candidates.change: Added Attempt/Repair phases and field-ownership evidence.

candidates.title: Independent lab computers
candidates.miss: Independent state needed a simpler first example before aliasing.
candidates.change: Added two receivers with one isolated mutation.

candidates.title: Point identity
candidates.miss: Equal state and identical object were easy to conflate.
candidates.change: Contrasted value comparison, identity comparison, and aliasing in one frame.

candidates.title: Library-book aliases
candidates.miss: Needed positioning after independent state and identity.
candidates.change: Retained as the transfer example and ordered it third.

candidates.title: Clinic-ticket reassignment
candidates.miss: Reference reassignment duplicated the alias lesson without a new observable consequence.
candidates.change: Removed in favor of the library example.

candidates.title: Grade range invariant
candidates.miss: Rejected updates needed clearer ownership language.
candidates.change: Kept the invariant example and added concept evidence support.

candidates.title: Recursive temperature setter
candidates.miss: The common self-assignment recursion error existed only in practice.
candidates.change: Added a caught failure followed by a backing-field repair.

candidates.title: Bank withdrawal invariant
candidates.miss: The state guard repeated the grade invariant with more domain vocabulary.
candidates.change: Removed because its distinctness score remained zero.

candidates.title: Student portal token
candidates.miss: Single and double underscores were explained but not visualized.
candidates.change: Added stored-name evidence and an explicit non-security warning.

candidates.title: Campus Person roles
candidates.miss: The existing delivery example introduced domain rules before the base relationship.
candidates.change: Added a low-context two-subclass hierarchy.

candidates.title: Shape hierarchy
candidates.miss: Duplicated lookup mechanics and competed with Shape in the abstraction topic.
candidates.change: Removed to avoid cross-topic conceptual blur.

candidates.title: Delivery pricing
candidates.miss: Needed a simpler example before it.
candidates.change: Retained as the transfer case after campus roles.

candidates.title: Missing intern base state
candidates.miss: super() success was shown, but the consequence of omitting it was not.
candidates.change: Added caught AttributeError and a same-object repair path.

candidates.title: Report exporter
candidates.miss: The topic jumped directly to ABC and risked defining abstraction as inheritance syntax.
candidates.change: Added interface-first hiding of formatting details without an ABC.

candidates.title: Shape area contract
candidates.miss: Students needed a compact contract-to-implementation bridge.
candidates.change: Added one abstract method and one concrete formula.

candidates.title: Payment method contract
candidates.miss: Needed positioning after abstraction and a minimal ABC.
candidates.change: Retained as the incomplete-subclass transfer case.

candidates.title: Standalone bank-transfer failure
candidates.miss: Repeated the exact incomplete-subclass evidence already present in PaymentMethod.
candidates.change: Removed and kept the failure inside the broader payment activity.

candidates.title: Classroom role introductions
candidates.miss: Notification channels were concrete but not the lightest introduction.
candidates.change: Added a two-object, one-message classroom loop.

candidates.title: Mixed shape areas
candidates.miss: Repeated dispatch while overloading Shape across three topics.
candidates.change: Removed to keep topic boundaries clearer.

candidates.title: Notification channels
candidates.miss: Only showed the successful pattern.
candidates.change: Retained for transfer and paired it with a type-switch contrast.

candidates.title: Delivery type switch
candidates.miss: Students could mistake isinstance or label branching for polymorphism.
candidates.change: Added a direct Attempt/Repair comparison with two runtime receivers.
